scenes.summary: Endfield Operator Thurston has discovered an attack site involving the Bonekrusher Clan in the Hub area. You've decided to investigate this unusual incident together.

lines.text: What's going on here?
Whoa! Sorry, I was completely absorbed there.
Hi there, Endmin. I'm Thurston, currently assisting the Hub Base in assessing safety conditions in Valley IV.
I was investigating nearby Landbreaker movements when I ... stumbled upon this place.
I'm not sure. If the Security Division or the UWST had done this, the base should've received an after-action report.
And besides, the state of this place is a bit ... well...
R-really? Thank you so much, Endmin!

options: Are you the one in charge?
Landbreakers taken out by someone else?
Someone's helping us?
Definitely worth looking into. Let's investigate together.

scenes.summary: Thurston has found another Bonekrusher attack site in the Hub area.

lines.text: Endmin, more Landbreakers have been taken down here too.
I've reviewed all available surveillance footage, but still have no additional findings.
Whoever the attacker is, they've got some serious skills.
Alright, I'll start by checking that big guy over there.

options: This close to the base...
Can't shake this uneasy feeling.
Let's see what clues we can gather here first.

scenes.summary: Thurston recognizes the dead Bonekrusher Executioner at the scene: "Guillotine" Gabbi, a notoriously tough fighter. Yet someone took him down with clean efficiency.

lines.text: Such clean technique. The fight probably ended very quickly.
I've been cramming intelligence files on the Bonekrusher Clan these past few days. This guy might be "Guillotine" Gabbi.
He's worked for many. Wasn't high priority on the watchlist, but definitely not someone to take lightly either.
A brute like this in a fight, yet almost no extra wounds ... every injury is lethal.
Anyway, I'll document his injuries first.

options: He looks incredibly strong though.
How could you tell?
The attacker's skills are seriously extraordinary...

lines.text: This Landbreaker only has one clean wound on the back of the neck. Aside from dust, there's almost no other staining on the body.
He didn't even have time to grip his weapon properly. Probably the first unlucky soul ambushed.
Containers were smashed with tremendous force, tiny cut marks are found on the railings.
The two types of damage likely came from different weapons. The axe-wielding Landbreaker clearly fought fiercely here.
The terminal appears to have been violently smashed, but the power supply is still intact.
Might need to bypass some damaged Originium circuits to get it started.

scenes.summary: You and Thurston believe "Guillotine" Gabbi was carrying out orders for someone when the attacker called "Shadow" swiftly eliminated him.

lines.text: Any ideas, Endmin?
These Landbreakers apparently received some kind of orders, but were wiped out before they could fully carry them out.
And they called that attacker "Shadow"... Is that a name or a title? Did they know each other before?
Anyway, the relevant data has been uploaded to SOW. Hopefully the experts back at base can provide more analysis.
I'll be keeping a close watch for any similar signs from now on. If I spot more traces, you'll be the first to know.
Understood, but leaving such a dangerous individual unchecked makes me really uneasy about the base's security.
We must get to the bottom of what happened here. I'll continue investigating. Please stay alert too.

options: A sudden ambush took place here.
The Landbreakers seemed to be trying to contact someone.
The attacker thwarted their plan.
Regardless, they're a ruthlessly efficient killer.
They're as dangerous as the Landbreakers themselves.
You should be careful too.
The enemy of my enemy isn't necessarily a friend.

True enough... Anyway, combining intel from the other locations should give us some concrete results now.
I'll ask around the Hub base for more intel. Please use the protocol synchronizer to submit the data to SOW.
The experts back at base should provide further analysis. We can retrieve their final report from the Intel Archive.
